title: English Practice Quiz 0996
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which sentence clearly reports an injury?
options: A visitor has injured their ankle near the entrance.
questions.explanation: A good incident report states what happened and where.

questions.question: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.explanation: Neither is singular in standard formal usage and takes is.

questions.question: A 'precaution' is an action taken to ___.
questions.explanation: A precaution is a preventive measure taken in advance.

questions.question: Which message is most useful in an emergency?
options: There is a fire alarm on the second floor. Please use the stairs.
questions.explanation: An emergency message should state the incident, location and safe action.

questions.question: The patient was advised ___ plenty of water.
questions.explanation: Advise someone is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: A 'symptom' is ___.
questions.explanation: A symptom is an indication that someone may have an illness.

questions.question: Which detail is essential in an incident report?
options: Date, time, location and factual description
questions.explanation: An incident report should record verifiable facts and key event details.

questions.question: The alarm sounded while the guards ___ the entrance.
questions.explanation: Past continuous describes an action in progress when another past event occurred.

questions.question: To 'evacuate' a building means to ___.
questions.explanation: Evacuate means move people away from danger to a safer place.

questions.question: Which instruction is firm but courteous?
questions.explanation: Please keep this passage clear is direct, respectful and easy to understand.
